text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our training session, I stick around
at the
track to observe how the other
students are
faring.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer? What're you still hanging
around
here for?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, who are you looking at? Hmph!
And right
after we finished training too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Stop looking! You're my trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine! I'll run another lap just for
you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then you'll see that only I deserve your
attention!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's how it's gonna be, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll show you what true running
looks like!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You better commit it to memory! The
majestic
form of the great and mighty
Teio!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, Tokai Teio enthralls me
with her
spectacular running.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Do you mean that in a good or
bad way?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the answer's obvious. But let's
hear it
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Teio heads off looking very pleased with
herself.
